capabilities: Render notes as images approximating Reading view via Obsidian's MarkdownRenderer
Export single notes, selections, or whole folders as images (ZIP on desktop)
Adjust width, theme, padding, media limits, and multi-page split in Export Studio
Add author bars and watermarks to exported images
Cache remote images per session and wait for fonts, diagrams, and images before capture
extras: Desktop is the primary target; mobile has reduced functionality (no ZIP, Copy may be unavailable, no auto re-render by default). Requires Obsidian 1.5.7+. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Additional developer docs live in README.dev.md and HANDOFF.md.
intentEvidence: Inspired by the community Export Image plugin — this project is a full rewrite and enhancement
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a rendered note as a single shareable image that keeps callouts, code, Mermaid, and embeds looking like Reading view.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the community Export Image plugin — this project is a full rewrite and enhancement

summary: Exports Markdown notes as images that approximate Obsidian Reading view, with an Export Studio for preview, layout, and decoration controls.
